messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Estimators with categorical data
parts:
On 08/12/2013 07:37 PM, Yigal Attali wrote:
> Another question about the same data, why do I get very different fit
> results when I use the WLSMVS estimator (poor fit) or default estimator
> (better fit, I assume WLSMV)?

It would appear that the two test statistics (WLSMV: simple second order
approach as used in Mplus 6/7, WLSMVS: classic satterthwaite correction)
give rather different results for your data. Interesting. Perhaps
someone should investigate this. (Mplus gives similar results, so this
is not a lavaan issue).

One caveat is that N=150, which is rather small for a model of this size.

Yves.
